description:
Kill a working specialist and all the work it is doing.

Name the specialist by its ID. It stops at its next safe point. When it has submitted an order, applied a payment or entered a sign-in whose outcome is not confirmed yet, it confirms that outcome first. A payment or sign-in card the user has not answered is withdrawn. Killing it does not undo anything it already did. A specialist another one called, such as the login a checkout called, can be killed too; its caller gets its stopped result, which says you stopped it, and carries on.

id.description: The specialist's ID, such as s3.
